feeds.title: Gayathri's Cook Spot
feeds.description: Gayathri is the author of Gayathri's Cook Spot. One of her hobbies has been baking. She realized her interest lay in eggless baking when they turned out so well she started investing more in cooking. Her mother taught her how to cook, do crafts, sew, and many other things that she is familiar with now. She has posted several recipes from her mother on this blog, and she contacts her with any questions. For more eggless baking recipes, bookmark this blog.

feeds.title: Veena Azmanov
feeds.description: Eggless cake recipes are a must-have on hand if you entertain or have loved ones that have egg allergies. Here on this blog, it's not just about the recipes or tutorials. It's about teaching you the techniques and giving you the tools. It's about making you a better cook, a better baker, a better cake decorator.

feeds.title: Mommy's Home Cooking » Eggless Baking Tips
feeds.description: Baking without eggs can be intimidating but Mommy's Home Cooking got you covered! Discover tricks that make eggless baking a success. From How to Make a Cake Mix Box without Eggs to How to Make Eggless Ice Cream. Authored by Oriana Romero.

feeds.title: my eggless world
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jacquelynn Spinney. I have been cooking and baking without eggs for over 10 years with many successes! I hope to help families who have just discovered their child is allergic to eggs by posting recipes that really work and that do not compromise on taste.

feeds.title: Divine Taste » Eggless Baking
feeds.description: Whether you are allergic to eggs, avoid them for spiritual purposes, or do not use them for any other reasons, you will find a host of recipes here for eggless baking! Anushruti is a Mumbai based food writer, recipe developer, blogger, nutrition counsellor and food show host, specializing in Satvik and Ayurvedic cooking and food.
